node.title: QA.22 / W3 currency separation
node.statement: QA.22's exact six-row 16n^3 reserve bounds post-strip MCA bad slopes per ordered pair (u,v), whereas W3 bounds residual list codewords per received word U over the admissible family. No proved consumer theorem converts the former currency and quantifier order into the latter. QA.22 remains exact calibration/evidence but cannot instantiate a W3 paid or residual upper allocation; the direct list-side partition and budget identity must be used.
